title: Lakeside stall bound assumes a report cadence
description:
focuser_lakeside now ends a move with CH# and ALERT after 40 consecutive identical P<n> reports without DONE (indigo_focuser_lakeside.driver:223-229). The real controller report cadence during slow motion or backlash takeup is not established, so a healthy slow move might be stopped. Next: confirm on hardware or bound the stall by monotonic time instead of report count.
